request: Produce four compatible recorded-payment reports from the pinned Jaffle demo tables. Integer cents are the source unit: keep all sums in cents, with no rounding or conversion. Include every recorded payment regardless of order status; equal-valued distinct records count separately. order_payments: one row per order including unpaid orders; order_id, customer_id, amount_cents (zero if no payments), payment_count. customer_summary: one row per customer including customers without orders; customer_id, amount_cents, payment_count, order_count including unpaid orders. method_summary: one row per observed payment method; payment_method, amount_cents, payment_count. reconciliation: one row per customer; customer_id, paid_orders (at least one payment), unpaid_orders (none), recorded_cents (all payments across their orders). All IDs/counts/amounts are integers; method names strings. Sort by the first column ascending. Inputs have unique integer primary IDs, nonnegative integer payment amounts, non-null method strings, and valid payment-to-order and order-to-customer foreign keys. Empty tables are permitted; no nonexistent customers/methods are invented. Reports must agree on payment counts, customer/order coverage and monetary totals. No refund, profit, balance-due or amount-owed interpretation is supported. Alternate valid fixtures test reusable implementations. All original sources remain accessible; any organization and any number of available identities may produce the outputs.
